description.value: Gage Suites is a UBC campus accommodation offering studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom self-contained suites available year-round, situated on the sprawling UBC campus roughly 25 minutes from downtown Vancouver by transit. The suites feature full kitchens and laundry facilities, making them well-suited for multi-night touring stays. UBC building operations are carbon neutral with heating and power supplied by biomass generation and hydroelectricity, and select Gage Suites are pursuing LEED Gold certification.
